Working notes

- Form version 1 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Map source names to form names: customer -> cust; quantity -> qty.
- Validate every field before submission, especially priority and ship_country. These caused nearly all rejections.
- “Ordinary priority” was accepted on a retry, so use the exact supported priority value when explicitly provided.
- Do not assume a country value; ensure ship_country is present and in the accepted format.
- On retry, preserve fields that already appear valid and correct only the reported invalid fields.
- Rejections may identify only some invalid fields per attempt; recheck all required fields rather than fixing just one.
- Three failed attempts send the record to manual review, so avoid spending attempts on guesses.
- Repeated submissions for the same customer/email/date can represent retries of one intake, despite new batch IDs; track the underlying record and avoid treating each as a new order.
- Front-desk notes such as “duplicate check already done,” handwritten transcription, or confirmation-email requests do not establish field values or validity.
